notes:
First public release of the Cosmoria Launcher.

- Sign in with your Microsoft account (Xbox Live and Minecraft services); your Minecraft ownership is verified
  before you can play.
- Offline play stays available for up to 30 days for the account verified on this PC; your sign-in is kept in the
  Windows Credential Manager, never in a plain file.
- Java 25 is downloaded, verified and managed for you: nothing to install by hand.
- PLAY launches Minecraft 26.2 with Fabric and the Cosmoria modpack.
- Install, update and repair Cosmoria in one click: every download is verified, and an update is applied as a whole
  or rolled back, so an interruption never leaves a broken game.
- The launcher updates itself: new versions are announced, downloaded, signature-checked and installed in one click
  (or Later). Choose the stable or dev update channel in Settings.
- Every release is built and signed by our release pipeline; the launcher refuses any update that is not signed.
- Windows installer in English and French, Cosmoria branding, one launcher window at a time.
